keyDecisions.cross_schema_fk: NO - UUID columns only, validate via API
keyDecisions.quantity_sign: Client always positive, service applies sign based on type
keyDecisions.null_uniqueness: Use partial indexes for feature_flags and user_roles
keyDecisions.po_numbering: orders.order_sequences with FOR UPDATE for atomic increment
keyDecisions.idempotency_conflict: 409 on key reuse with different request body
keyDecisions.grn_partial: Each partial receive uses new idempotency key; received_quantity is cumulative
keyDecisions.event_matrix_correction: orders.po.received.v1 goes to notification/analytics ONLY - NOT inventory-service (GRN is sync)
keyDecisions.partial_unique_index: ux_pending_reorders_active WHERE status='pending' prevents duplicate pending reorders
keyDecisions.users_actor_check: chk_users_actor CHECK constraint ensures actor_type/actor_id consistency
keyDecisions.mvp_performance_indexes: 6 indexes: supplier_store_links, purchase_orders, po_items, store_products, inventory_ledger, pending_reorders
keyDecisions.role_seeds_jsonb_cast: All role permission seeds use explicit ::jsonb cast for migration safety
keyDecisions.barcode_uniqueness: ux_products_primary_barcode partial unique prevents duplicate barcodes (breaks auto-mapping)
keyDecisions.trigram_indexes: idx_products_name_trgm + idx_products_brand_trgm for fast catalog search
keyDecisions.integer_quantities: Inventory API uses INTEGER (not number/float) to prevent 0.5 unit issues
keyDecisions.event_envelope: Canonical DomainEvent<TPayload> wrapper with eventId, eventType, occurredAt, correlationId, producer, payload
keyDecisions.redis_durability_clarified: Ledger correct even if Redis loses jobs (GRN/SALE sync); read-model may go stale
keyDecisions.integer_quantities_api: All quantity fields in API bodies use INTEGER (purchase-orders, receive, reorder approve)
keyDecisions.bounds_check_constraints: chk_store_link_bounds, chk_order_item_bounds, chk_reorder_policy_bounds prevent negative/invalid values
keyDecisions.product_barcodes_table: catalog.product_barcodes normalizes barcodes (replaces alternate_barcodes JSONB) with global uniqueness
keyDecisions.service_to_service_auth: Forward user JWT + X-Service-Name header for internal calls (GRN flow)
keyDecisions.deadlock_prevention: Sort items by product_id before FOR UPDATE to prevent cross-transaction deadlocks
keyDecisions.catalog_stock_backfill: POST /internal/catalog/reconcile-stock for read-model recovery from ledger
keyDecisions.idempotency_status: idempotency_keys.status column (processing/completed/failed) prevents concurrent duplicate processing
keyDecisions.event_ordering_ledger: InventoryStockChangedV1.ledgerCreatedAt preferred over occurredAt for consumer ordering
keyDecisions.error_envelope: Standard ApiError envelope with code, message, details, field, requestId for all error responses
keyDecisions.store_code_denormalized: orders.order_sequences.store_code denormalized from platform.stores for PO number generation
keyDecisions.users_identifier_check: chk_users_identifier CHECK (email OR phone required) - at least one identifier must be present
keyDecisions.aggregate_id_widened: event_outbox.aggregate_id VARCHAR(100) to support compound IDs

mvpTickets.title: Database Schema Setup (All Services)
mvpTickets.description: Create all database tables across all microservices with proper indexes. All store_id fields are UUID with NO cross-schema foreign keys.
acceptanceCriteria: Auth tables: users (with chk_users_actor CHECK), roles, user_roles, device_tokens, refresh_tokens, password_reset_tokens
Supplier tables: suppliers, supplier_store_links, supplier_requests, event_outbox
Catalog tables: products, store_products (sell_price NULLABLE!, stock_last_event_at TIMESTAMPTZ), supplier_products, supplier_product_map, catalog_mapping_log, event_inbox
Inventory tables: inventory_ledger (with reference_sub_id for partial GRN), stock_balances (FOR UPDATE locking), idempotency_keys, event_inbox, event_outbox

Reorder tables: reorder_policies, store_reorder_settings, pending_reorders (with ux_pending_reorders_active partial unique index), reorder_runs, idempotency_keys, event_inbox, event_outbox
All store_id columns are UUID (NO foreign keys to platform.stores)
ALL TIMESTAMP columns must be TIMESTAMPTZ (timezone-aware)
NULL uniqueness: feature_flags and user_roles use partial indexes (ux_*_global, ux_*_scoped)
CHECK constraints on scope_type/scope_id consistency (including chk_users_actor)

mvpTickets.title: Inventory Ledger Service
mvpTickets.description: Implement ledger-based inventory service where stock = SUM(delta_qty). This is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for stock.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /stores/{storeId}/inventory - Get stock levels for all products
GET /stores/{storeId}/inventory/{productId} - Get stock + recent ledger entries
GET /stores/{storeId}/inventory/{productId}/ledger - Full ledger history
POST /stores/{storeId}/inventory/transactions - Record sale, GRN, return (requires X-Idempotency-Key)
QUANTITY SIGN RULE: Client always sends POSITIVE quantity, service applies delta based on type
Type 'sale' => -quantity (decrease), 'sale_return'/'purchase_received' => +quantity (increase)
POST /stores/{storeId}/inventory/adjust - Manual stock adjustment (admin only, requires X-Idempotency-Key)
Stock computation: SUM(delta_qty) per store+product
Write to event_outbox in same transaction as ledger entry
Publish inventory.stock.changed.v1 event via outbox worker
get_current_stock(store_id, product_id) SQL function
inventory_ledger is APPEND-ONLY - never update/delete rows
mvpTickets.technicalNotes: inventory_ledger is the ONLY source of truth for stock. store_products.current_stock is a READ-MODEL updated via events only. Client sends positive quantities; service determines sign. V3.0.4: reference_sub_id column stores receiveId for partial GRN audit trail. V3.0.5: All quantities are INTEGER (no decimals). Events use DomainEvent<InventoryStockChangedV1> envelope.

inventory.stock.changed.v1 event published

Cart shows real-time stock from inventory API (not cached)

mvpTickets.title: Purchase Order Service
mvpTickets.description: Implement purchase order CRUD, status management, and GRN receiving. GRN calls inventory-service synchronously.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /stores/{storeId}/purchase-orders - Create from cart
POST /stores/{storeId}/purchase-orders/from-reorders - Create from approved reorders
GET /stores/{storeId}/purchase-orders - List with filters
GET /stores/{storeId}/purchase-orders/{id} - Order detail with items and events
POST /stores/{storeId}/purchase-orders/{id}/submit - Send to supplier
POST /stores/{storeId}/purchase-orders/{id}/cancel - Cancel order
POST /stores/{storeId}/purchase-orders/{id}/receive - GRN receiving (CALLS inventory-service sync)
Order number format: PO-{storeCode}-{YY}-{000001}
Status transitions with validation (state machine)
order_events logging for all status changes
Write to event_outbox in same transaction
Publish orders.po.created.v1, orders.po.status_changed.v1, orders.po.received.v1 via Bull queue
GRN calls inventory-service POST /inventory/transactions internally with type=purchase_received
GRN only updates PO status AFTER inventory-service returns success
mvpTickets.statusFlow: draft -> submitted -> confirmed -> shipped -> delivered | cancelled | partial_received
mvpTickets.technicalNotes: CRITICAL: order-service NEVER writes to inventory_ledger directly. GRN must call inventory-service synchronously. If inventory-service fails, GRN fails. V3.0.4: GRN call includes referenceSubId=receiveId for audit. orders.po.received.v1 event goes to notification/analytics ONLY - NOT inventory-service. PARTIAL GRN: Each partial receive requires a NEW idempotency key. order_items.received_quantity is CUMULATIVE (add each receive, don't replace). order_sequences table uses FOR UPDATE for atomic PO number generation.

mvpTickets.title: Idempotency Keys Implementation
mvpTickets.description: Implement idempotency key middleware for all mutation endpoints across services.
acceptanceCriteria: X-Idempotency-Key header required on all POST/PUT mutations
idempotency_keys table in orders, inventory, reorder schemas
Key format: client-generated UUID
24-hour TTL on keys
On duplicate key with SAME request_hash: return cached response (200)
On duplicate key with DIFFERENT request_hash: return 409 Conflict
Store request_hash (SHA256 of body) to detect key reuse
409 response: { code: 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED', message: 'Key already used with different request body' }
Middleware: checkIdempotencyKey() before handler
Middleware: saveIdempotencyKey() after handler

mvpTickets.title: Event Inbox + Consumer Deduplication
mvpTickets.description: Implement event inbox pattern for consumer-side deduplication across services.
acceptanceCriteria: event_inbox table in inventory, reorder, catalog schemas
Before processing: check if event_id exists in inbox
If exists and processed: skip (idempotent)
If exists and failed: retry (increment retry_count)
After processing: mark as 'processed' with timestamp
On error: mark as 'failed' with error_message
Max 3 retries before dead-letter
handleEvent() wrapper function for all consumers

mvpTickets.title: Outbox + Bull Queue Integration
mvpTickets.description: Implement reliable event delivery using outbox pattern with Bull queues (NOT Redis pub/sub).
acceptanceCriteria: event_outbox table in orders, inventory, reorder, supplier schemas
writeToOutbox() helper function (same transaction as business data)
Outbox worker: polls pending events every 1s
Add to Bull queue (backed by Redis)
Bull queue setup for event consumers
Retry logic for failed publishes (max 3 retries with exponential backoff)
Dead letter queue for failed events
Mark events as 'published' with timestamp
Correlation-ID propagation through events
Consumer registration pattern
NO Redis pub/sub - Bull queues only (durable!)
mvpTickets.technicalNotes: Redis pub/sub is NOT durable - drops messages if consumers are down. Bull queues persist to Redis and guarantee delivery. CRITICAL: Redis MUST have AOF persistence enabled (appendonly yes, appendfsync everysec). Without AOF, Redis restart = lost jobs = data corruption. V3.0.4: orders.po.received.v1 consumers are notification/analytics ONLY - NOT inventory-service (GRN is synchronous call).

Skip if pending reorder already exists for product (ux_pending_reorders_active index prevents race)
Find best supplier (priority, then price, then stock)
Create pending_reorder with suggested_quantity = target - current
Write to event_outbox for reorder.draft.created.v1
Log run stats to reorder_runs table (evaluated_products, created_pending, skipped_existing)
Handle errors gracefully - log to reorder_runs.error_message
